notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures, at least one of which has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
The creature dies, triggering Basri's Lieutenant and Odric's Outrider.
Resolve the Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
Resolve the Odric's Outrider trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on another creature you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
